INV-01.reason: One business implementation per operation is the same obligation as IF-02: adapters do not implement business rules.

INV-02.reason: Every interface calls the operation is the IF-01 adapter call contract.

INV-03.reason: Authorization inside the operation is OPS-07.

INV-04.reason: No transport types in core and operation is ARC-03.

INV-05.reason: SSO addition leaves existing operation signatures and business references unchanged; CONF-42 states the same regression obligation.

INV-07.reason: A token for one interface is rejected by another; AUTH-08 fixes the audience rule.

INV-08.reason: No side effect before authorization succeeds is the same obligation as OPS-06.
